description: This Java class 'LibraryThingBookDataImport' resides in the package related to importing book data from LibraryThing. It manages a collection of 'LibraryThingBookImport' objects stored in a map, and provides a method to retrieve these objects as a list.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookDataImport
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a collection of imported books from LibraryThing, providing functionality to retrieve the collection as a list.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Returns the collection of imported books as a List.
